subject: Confirmation of Flight Booking
body: Dear [Recipient], We are pleased to confirm your flight booking from New York to Los Angeles on July 15, 2022. Your itinerary details are as follows: Flight Number: ABC123 Departure: 10:00 AM Arrival: 1:00 PM Seat: 22A We look forward to serving you on board. For any inquiries or changes, please contact our customer service team. Thank you for choosing our airline. Safe travels! Best regards, The Airline Team
